series.units: mm, area mean over the region

series.measures: standing water outside the reference water mask
series.present_may_exceed_due_because: due_slots is computed from a conservative 3-day composite latency. When the product publishes sooner, present legitimately exceeds due. A validator asserting present <= due would fail this series for being correct.
cannot_say_reason: across 20 years the flood measure tracks how much the satellite could see (rank correlation +0.82), so a ranking here would rank clear skies rather than floods
the median week holds 174 flood pixels, below the 300 at which the two MODIS products stop agreeing
series.cannot_say_summary: the satellite that measures flooding here cannot see through the cloud that causes it
